motions.item_title: Review of the Ontario Land Tribunal and Enhancing Deference to Municipal Planning Decisions
motions.text: That the Government of Ontario be requested to review the role and mandate of the Ontario Land Tribunal to ensure greater respect for municipal planning decisions that are supported by evidence, public consultation, and approved planning policies. That the Province consider amendments to the Planning Act and Ontario Land Tribunal Act to provide stronger deference to municipal decisions that align with provincial planning frameworks and Official Plans. That the Province improve transparency and accountability within the Ontario Land Tribunal by requiring clear and detailed reasoning when municipal decisions are overturned. That the Province explore measures to reduce the financial burden on municipalities defending planning decisions before the OLT, helping to protect taxpayer dollars and improve the efficiency of the planning process. That staff be directed to circulate this resolution to the Premier of Ontario, the Minister of Municipal Affairs and Housing, Local Members of Provincial Parliament, the Association of Municipalities of Ontario (AMO), and all Ontario municipalities for consideration and support.
motions.text_html:
1. That the Government of Ontario be requested to review the role and mandate of the Ontario Land Tribunal to ensure greater respect for municipal planning decisions that are supported by evidence, public consultation, and approved planning policies.
  2. That the Province consider amendments to the Planning Act and Ontario Land Tribunal Act to provide stronger deference to municipal decisions that align with provincial planning frameworks and Official Plans.
  3. That the Province improve transparency and accountability within the Ontario Land Tribunal by requiring clear and detailed reasoning when municipal decisions are overturned.
  4. That the Province explore measures to reduce the financial burden on municipalities defending planning decisions before the OLT, helping to protect taxpayer dollars and improve the efficiency of the planning process.
  5. That staff be directed to circulate this resolution to the Premier of Ontario, the Minister of Municipal Affairs and Housing, Local Members of Provincial Parliament, the Association of Municipalities of Ontario (AMO), and all Ontario municipalities for consideration and support.

motions.text: That staff be directed to review options to modify the constructed streetscape on the east side of Wyndham Street between Carden Street and Macdonell Street to more closely align with the 90% detailed design presented publicly on September 18, 2025, while protecting the newly created area, and that staff report back to City Council in Q1 2027 with the options, estimated costs, constraints, and recommendations to amend the existing infrastructure associated with each option. That staff be directed to review the completed detail design works of the downtown reconstruction project and identify any material differences between the detailed design and the constructed works and report any findings to City Council in Q1 2027.
motions.text_html:
1. That staff be directed to review options to modify the constructed streetscape on the east side of Wyndham Street between Carden Street and Macdonell Street to more closely align with the 90% detailed design presented publicly on September 18, 2025, while protecting the newly created area, and that staff report back to City Council in Q1 2027 with the options, estimated costs, constraints, and recommendations to amend the existing infrastructure associated with each option.
  2. That staff be directed to review the completed detail design works of the downtown reconstruction project and identify any material differences between the detailed design and the constructed works and report any findings to City Council in Q1 2027.
